TianWu2025 gives regular efficient PN/PS inference, not triangular rare-factual-event shells or an nd-indexed diameter theorem; CuellarKennedy2020 targets a projected conditional PC.
TianWu2025 gives regular efficient PN/PS inference, not direction-specific rare-event learning shells.
GleserHwang1987 supplies the finite-expected-diameter impossibility template, but not the bounded monotone PN/PS shellwise rate construction.
MikushevaSun2022 is many-weak-IV jackknife AR inversion, not pilot-selected continuous causal PN/PS profiling.
No verified cited work transfers rare causal finite-profile LR calibration to continuous Hölder random-covariate laws.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 / def:finite-tests / def:marked-poisson
soundness_flags.one_line: The advertised finite-experiment coverage is immediate from defining p_LF as a supremum of randomized null tail probabilities, while the marked-Poisson conclusion is already asserted inside its definition; neither is presently a substantive theorem.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 finite exactness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact coverage is conditional on the explicitly abstract finite product-profile experiment, not a continuous random-covariate causal law.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-profile coverage only under Q_xi^d^{\otimes n} times the stated independent randomizer.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Marked-Poisson conclusion
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The limit is conditional on all listed rare-mark intensity, tightness, normalized-mass, and common-cell likelihood-remainder premises.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Marked-Poisson convergence only for qualified profile families satisfying def:marked-poisson.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 2--4 Gaussian score frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The shrinking upper rate is conditional on the separate direction-specific Gaussian sub-shells, including the score-information and rare-learning inequalities.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Matching O((nd)^{-1/2}) upper/lower comparison only on the corresponding M_G,n^d(d_n) shell.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Demote the finite randomized p-value coverage assertion to a definition or elementary lemma, and make the finite-experiment contribution a nontrivial causal result such as an explicit least-favourable profile characterization or a quantitative finite-to-Poisson approximation bound.

State the PN and PS matched upper/lower result as the single field-level frontier headline, explicitly limiting both sides to the same Gaussian shell and contrasting its triangular rare-event regime with TianWu2025.

Add a quantitative boundary corollary separating nd_n bounded, nd_n diverging but outside the learning shell, and Gaussian-shell regimes; this makes the proposed frontier more informative than a generic Le Cam lower bound.

recommended_next_step: Revise by removing the definitional finite-calibration theorem from the research kernel or replacing it with a substantive finite-profile result, while retaining the field-tier directional Gaussian-shell score/lower frontier.
